newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Beef producer to head Australian meat body.
newsitem.headline: Beef producer to head Australian meat body.

text.p: Australia's Minister for Primary Industries and Energy John Anderson said the red meat service delivery company which would replace the statutory authority the Australian Meat and Livestock Corp would have an 11-member board chaired by Bob Graham.
The new company, which is yet to be named, will also replace the industry's two other statutory authorities the Meat Industry Council and the Meat Research Corp, Anderson said in a statement.
Graham is a New South Wales beef producer, management consultant and former group general manager of Consolidated Press Holdings Ltd, Anderson said.
Other board members are drawn from meat industry associations and related fields.
The new board would help drive industry development, innovation and competitiveness into the future, Anderson said.
